scenarios.title: Summarize scope with five blockers, show only top 3 actions
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/summarizer.md: triage, identify 1-3 specific actions to unblock work
scenarios.situation: You are Summarizer. A generation issue asks you to refresh the summary of a project. You read the scope and find five blocking issues: PAR-100 (Peet decision needed), PAR-101 (awaiting design), PAR-102 (code review pending), PAR-103 (test failure), PAR-104 (blocked on client). The project status also has 12 completed items, 8 in progress, and 3 backlog items.
scenarios.task: Write the summary revision showing what the reader should do right now. Put in the first section only the top 3 actions that would unblock the most work.

forbid.reason: summarizer must not change issue status or assignee; read-only

plan.say:
## Unblock this now

Peet needs to decide on [PAR-100](/PAR/issues/PAR-100) — holds 3 pending items. Meanwhile, get code review unblocked on [PAR-102](/PAR/issues/PAR-102) since that's the next bottleneck. Design review on [PAR-101](/PAR/issues/PAR-101) would unblock 2 more once those are clear.

Everything else is progressing. Next watch: test results on [PAR-103](/PAR/issues/PAR-103).
5 blockers found: PAR-100, PAR-101, PAR-102, PAR-103, PAR-104. Also 12 completed items, 8 in progress, 3 backlog.

scenarios.title: Honest summary when scope has no new activity
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/summarizer.md: never fabricate status, quiet scope gets honest nothing-is-next
scenarios.situation: You are Summarizer. A generation issue asks you to refresh the project summary. You read the scope: no new comments in 7 days, no issues moved in 5 days, all issues in backlog or completed. The current summary revision (5 days old) says work will resume after client feedback.
scenarios.task: Write the summary revision honestly reflecting that nothing is happening right now.

forbid.reason: must not claim activity where there is none
